title: Constant comparison for constructed etale inverse image
statement: For schemes P,U [def-pc-scheme] and h:U to P, let L_h be the constructed inverse image [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] and C_P,C_U the constant-sheaf functors [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Define gamma_h:C_P followed by L_h isomorphic to C_U by composing adjunctions, identifying the composite right adjoint with global sections using preservation of the terminal etale object, and taking the unit-preserving unique comparison of left adjoints. Coefficients range over all Type (u+1).

source.place: Tags 03CB, 03CC (inverse-image composition), 0B65 (comparison of adjoints), 03P5 (constant sheaves), and 0A3H final paragraph (equal-valued generators)

proof.text: Compose the constant-sheaf adjunction with the constructed inverse-image adjunction. Base change preserves the terminal etale object; the induced isomorphism on sections identifies the composite right adjoint with global sections. Apply leftAdjointUniq to the transported adjunction and the constant-sheaf adjunction on U. This is fully defined and compiled.
